  MINUTES

  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights Planning Commission
  November 25, 2014

Opening Ceremonies

Regular Business

1.  Call  Meeting  to Order — At 6: 00 p. m. Chairman Black called the Regular
Planning Commission Meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Chairman  Larry Black, Vice- Chair Dominick DiMario, Commissioners Ray
Fernandez, Ross Owen, Greg Steffire and Alternate Eric Grimm

Also Present: John Brown,  City Attorney; Ben Kim, Principal Planner; and Sandra
Studer, Deputy City Clerk/ Records Manager

Absent: None

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

Planning Commissioner Steffire stated that the Minutes of March 25, 2014 needed a
correction under item No. 2 to read " Vice-Chairman Dominick DiMario" rather than the
current  Co- Chairman Dominick DiMario.  Also, on the Minutes of April 22, 2014 the
same correction needed to be made as well as a correction to the spelling of his name
as his name had been spelled with a " D" rather than an " S".

Action: Moved ( Fernandez),  se conded ( Steffire),  and voted 5- 0 to approve consent
agenda item numbers 5 through 7 with the amendments to the minutes as suggested.

5.  Minutes of March 25, 2014— Regular Meeting

  VIEW THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING LIVE AT: WWW. LHHCITY. ORG
 6.  Minutes of April 22, 2014— Regular Meeting

7.  Monthly Community Development Department Report

 Public Hearing

8.  Resolution 2014-02 Recommending that the City Council Approve the
  Ordinance Amending Articles 4, 7, and 8 of the Municipal Code

Action: Moved ( Stefflre), seconded ( Fernandez), and voted 5- 0 to adopt Resolution No.
2014-02 A Resolution of the Planning Commission of the City of La Habara Heights
Recommending Approval of An Ordinance Amending Portions of Articles 4, 7, and 8 of
the Municipal Code with the administrative corrections as mentioned.

 Staff Comments

None

Planning Commission Comments

Requested by: Commissioner Fernandez made a request that the matter of story poles
and  definitions be  brought  back for discussion  at  a  future meeting. There was
consensus of the Commissioners to bring back the matter of story poles at the next
Regular Planning Commission meeting.

Adioum Meeting— At 7: 08 p. m. Chairman Black adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Planning Commission Approval
